memo.objective: Assess whether purchases follow the Contract Procedure Rules where the spend data shows indicators of split purchases and repeat payments [rule:CPR-11] [rule:CPR-30].
memo.approach: Targeted testing of the flagged windows [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].headline_general_procurement.windows] and repeat-amount groups [metric:$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.by_tag.general_procurement.groups], drawn from the full population.
memo.limitations: The data covers {{$.population.months_covered|int}} months of payments and no contract register is available [metric:$.contracts.register_present].

controls.description: Requirements are valued as a whole before the procurement route is chosen; disaggregation is not used to fall under a threshold [rule:CPR-11].
Purchases at or above the quotation threshold follow the Appendix B route [rule:CPR-56] [rule:CPR-57].

tests.step: For each sampled window, establish whether the payments relate to one requirement and, if so, whether its total value was assessed and the Appendix B route followed [rule:CPR-11] [rule:CPR-56].
pbc: Purchase orders and invoices for each sampled window
Quotations or tender records for the requirement each window relates to

controls.description: Each payment is matched to a distinct approved invoice and order before release [rule:CPR-30].

tests.step: Trace each payment in the sampled groups to a distinct invoice and order; record any credit or recovery [rule:CPR-30].
pbc: Invoices and purchase orders for each sampled payment
Purchase orders and invoices for each sampled window

rules_not_tested.reason: Publication of spend over the reporting threshold is a transparency duty the payment sample does not test.
The lower quotation tier is below the competition threshold sampled in this plan.
